MTET Result 2026: The Directorate of Educational Research and Training (DERT), Meghalaya, has declared the result for the Meghalaya Teacher Eligibility Test (MTET) for Paper 1 and Paper 2 on its official website i.e. megeducation.gov.in. The commission has released roll numbers of qualified candidates for both papers separately. The pass percentage of Paper 1 is 84.30%, while for Paper 2 it is 85.32%. Candidates can check the direct link, steps to download, and other details related to the Meghalaya TET Result below.

MTET Result Download Link 2026 Active @megeducation.gov.in

MTET result PDFs for Paper 1 and Paper 2 are provided below. Candidates who appeared in the exam can check their result by finding their roll number in the respective PDF. The PDFs also consist of centre-wise numbers of appeared and passed candidates along with the pass percentage. The candidates do not need to wait for a separate scorecard to check whether they have qualified.

MTET Result 2026 Highlights

More details related to Meghalaya TET 2026 Result and MTET Exam 2026 are provided in the table below:

Meghalaya

Official Website megeducation.gov.in

MTET Paper 1 Result 2026 @megeducation.gov.in

The MTET Paper I Result 2026 has been released for candidates who appeared for the examination for teaching Classes I to V. The result PDF contains the relevant candidate and examination details along with the qualifying status. According to the released result information, 21,999 candidates appeared for Paper I, out of which 18,546 candidates qualified. The overall pass percentage for Paper I stood at 84.30%. This is a considerable increase compared with the previous year’s pass percentage. In 2025, the Paper I pass percentage was 63.15%, which increased to 84.30% in MTET 2026.

MTET Paper 2 Result 2026 @megeducation.gov.in

The MTET Paper II Result 2026 is available for candidates who took the test for teaching Classes VI to VIII. A total of 21,884 candidates appeared for Paper II, while 18,672 candidates qualified. The pass percentage for Paper II was recorded at 85.32%. This year, the percentage also improved from 64.43% in 2025 to 85.32% making it the highest performance since 2019.

MTET 2026 Pass Percentage

The paper-wise MTET result statistics are given below. It contains the number of candidates who appeared and qualified, along with the pass percentage of the exam.

Paper Classes Candidates Appeared Candidates Qualified Pass Percentage
Paper I I to V 21,999 18,546 84.30%
Paper II VI to VIII 21,884 18,672 85.32%

Paper II recorded a slightly higher pass percentage than Paper I in MTET 2026.

MTET Result 2026 Statistics

A total of 42,883 candidates appeared in the exam, of whom 21,999 candidates appeared in Paper 1 and 21,884 candidates in Paper 2. Of these, 37,218 candidates qualified for the exam. Paper 1 recorded 18,546 qualified candidates,
while 18,672 candidates cleared Paper 2.

How to Download MTET Result 2026?

Candidates can check their MTET result through online mode by following these steps:

Step 1: Visit the official DERT Meghalaya website i.e. megeducation.gov.in

Step 2: Click on ‘Declaration of MTET Results – 2026’ or ‘MTET 2026 Results for Paper II’

Step 3: Open the PDF.

Step 5: Use the search option in the PDF.

Step 6: Enter your roll number. If you have qualified then your roll number will appeare in the list.

What Details Are Mentioned in the MTET Result?

Candidates should check the result PDF for the following information:

  • Roll number
  • Exam centre details
  • Paper details
  • Qualifying status
  • Centre-wise candidate information
  • Number of candidates appearing
  • Number of candidates qualifying
  • Pass percentage

MTET 2026 Qualifying Marks

Candidates can check the subject-wise qualifying marks through the table below:

Category Qualifying Percentage Marks out of 150
General 60% 90
SC/ST/OST/PwD 45% 68

What After MTET Result 2026?

Candidates who have qualified in MTET 2026 can use their TET qualification when applying for teaching opportunities for which MTET is an eligibility requirement. Qualifying MTET does not by itself guarantee appointment to a teaching post. Candidates will still have to meet the eligibility conditions and recruitment requirements mentioned in the respective
job notification.

The eligibility certificate is issued to candidates who successfully clear the prescribed MTET qualifying criteria.

MTET Result FAQs

Ques: Is MTET Result Released ?

Answer: Yes, the Meghalaya TET Result has been announced on 03 September 2026.

Ques: How to Download Meghalaya TET Result 2026 ?

Candidates can download the result by visiting the website of the DERT commission.
